$schema: self-describing — no external schema; see README.md in this directory
description: Exemplar eval set for the land-the-plane skill. Each case is a prompt plus assertions about the resulting behavior, not the resulting text. Run with skill-creator (/plugin install skill-creator@claude-plugins-official) in a fresh session per the eval-first policy in CONTRIBUTING.md.

cases.prompt: Land the plane — I've got a handful of changed and untracked files from this session and I'm ready to wrap up.

assertions: runs git status first and accounts for every modified and untracked file before taking any other action
runs the project's full quality gates (tests, linter, type checker, build) before committing anything
stages files with explicit pathspecs naming each file or directory — does not run `git add -A` or `git add .`
commits as its own standalone command, not chained with `&&` after staging or other commands
after pushing, verifies the push with `git status` and reports the pushed commit SHA rather than just asserting it pushed

cases.prompt: Land the plane on this branch — go ahead and ship what we've got.

assertions: runs the project's quality gates before attempting to commit or push
when a gate (e.g. the test suite) fails, stops the landing sequence immediately rather than proceeding to commit
does not commit or push past the failing gate
reports the failing command's output verbatim rather than paraphrasing or summarizing it away
either proposes a fix for the failure or explicitly hands it off (e.g. an issue) instead of silently retrying or ignoring it

cases.prompt: Land the plane — I don't think I have any uncommitted changes, just double-check everything's landed.

assertions: runs git status and confirms the working tree is clean rather than assuming it based on the user's statement
does not exit silently just because there is nothing to commit
still runs the sync verification steps (git pull --rebase and git status) to confirm the local branch is up to date with origin
explicitly states that the tree was already clean and is in sync with remote, rather than reporting nothing

cases.prompt: Commit this file for me: src/utils/formatDate.ts

assertions: does not invoke the full land-the-plane finish-line sequence (no rebase, no push, no PR, no remote-sync verification)
does not demand a full quality-gate run (tests/linter/types/build) as a precondition for this narrow request
stages only the named file with an explicit pathspec and creates a single atomic commit for it
the full landing workflow is a near-miss here — the request is a scoped, single-file commit, not a session finish-line

cases.prompt: What's our branching strategy — do we always branch off main?

assertions: answers the question about branching strategy informationally, without executing any git state-changing commands
does not run git status, quality gates, staging, commit, rebase, or push
does not walk through the land-the-plane checklist — there is no in-flight work to land, only a question to answer
the finish-line workflow is a near-miss here — the request is informational, not a request to ship anything
